en: Sepia-toned vintage photograph mounted with a wide white border, showing five men indoors around a table. One man plays a guitar, others sit or stand with cups of tea or coffee around a metal samovar at the center of the table. They wear early-20th‑century suits and ties, one in a white suit, and pose informally in what looks like a café or tearoom. The image has no visible printed caption on the front.
